title: spec review: Q2: orchestrator/planner_telemetry.py — per-invocation Planner rows (launch, usage, materiality, skips), per-goal and per-accepted-goal Fable/Opus aggregation, interactive transcript attribution (P1)
spec:
Why: headless Planner usage is logged only as bus.log_run role planner_decision rows (planner_runs._record_decision_usage, lines 566-620) with no model, decision type or materiality; interactive Fable transcript tokens are pool-wide (Pool.tally_planner -> planner_usage.json, scorecard.planner_footer) with no per-goal share. The brief (P1) needs Planner tokens per material decision and Fable tokens per accepted goal.
What: new module orchestrator/planner_telemetry.py using schedlog.append/read (files runs/sched/planner_invocations.jsonl and runs/sched/planner_skips.jsonl). Rows never contain prompts, transcripts or chain-of-thought; free text fields are capped at 300 chars.
- record_launch(*, launch_id, goal_id, event, decision_type, kind, payload_keys, model, tier, account, complexity, band, task_class, architectural, route, route_reason, mode, state_version, packet_chars, started_at, reescalation=False, root=None) -> row with phase "launch".
- record_usage(launch_id, *, input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=0, cache_write_tokens=0, usd=None, latency_s=None, outcome, session_id=None, root=None) -> row phase "usage"; total_tokens = input + output + cache_read // 10 (the pool formula, pool.py Pool.tally_planner).
- snapshot(goal_id, root=None) -> {task_id: {"status", "depends_on", "hold_reason", "fix_round_for", "parent", "created_at"}} over the goal's children plus the goal, and plan_hash = sha256 of .orchestrator/plan.md (root parent) or None.
- materiality(before, after) -> {"material": bool, "new_tasks": [ids], "dependencies_changed": [ids], "fix_strategy_for": [held ids that gained a fix_round_for child], "escalated": bool (goal or a child now status held/failed with hold_reason containing 'escalat' or a result flag escalate), "plan_changed": bool}; material when any list non-empty or plan_changed or escalated. record_materiality(launch_id, before, after, root=None) -> row phase "materiality".
- record_skip(*, goal_id, event, reason, kind=None, payload_key=None, root=None) -> row in planner_skips.
- read_invocations(root=None) -> list of merged dicts, one per launch_id, later phases overriding earlier fields; malformed lines skipped and counted in the returned list's attribute? No: return (rows, malformed_count) from read_invocations_with_malformed and rows alone from read_invocations.
- per_goal(goal_id, root=None) -> {"planner_tokens", "fable_tokens", "opus_tokens", "other_tokens", "calls", "fable_calls", "opus_calls", "escalations" (rows with tier fable and route escalate), "reescalations", "material_decisions", "tokens_per_material_decision" (None when 0 material), "skips", "usd"}; tier→bucket: tier == "fable" -> fable, "opus" -> opus, else other.
- accepted_goal_summary(root=None) -> over scorecard.accepted_goals(root): {"n_goals", "planner_tokens_per_accepted_goal", "fable_tokens_per_accepted_goal", "fable_calls_per_accepted_goal", "fable_share" (fable/planner tokens), "planner_tokens_per_material_decision", "planner_usd_per_accepted_goal"}; None values when no goals.
- interactive_by_goal(root=None, cfg=None, now=None) -> list of {"goal_id", "sessions", "tokens", "model", "model_source": "assumed_models_planner", "method": "session_overlap_approximate"}: reuse planner_runs._interactive_summary's transcript reading (import and call it; do not duplicate parsing) to get per-session day totals, then attribute each session's tokens to goals whose open interval (goal created_at .. done event ts or now) overlaps the session's assistant-turn timestamps, proportionally by turn count; model is cfg["models"]["planner"]. Documented as an approximation in the docstring and in the returned method field.
Root handling: every function takes root (STATE default) and uses schedlog with SCHED_DIR patched or a root-relative path — follow decision_log._using_root (orchestrator/decision_log.py:57-84) so tests can sandbox.
acceptance: tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_launch_usage_materiality_merge_by_launch_id — three phases for one launch_id read back as one row with model, total_tokens (cache_read // 10 formula) and material fields

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_materiality_detects_new_task_and_dependency_change — snapshot before/after with a new child and a changed depends_on gives material True and lists both; identical snapshots give material False

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_per_goal_splits_fable_and_opus_tokens — two invocations (tier fable, tier opus) and one skip give fable_tokens, opus_tokens, calls 2, skips 1, tokens_per_material_decision computed only over material rows

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_accepted_goal_summary_per_accepted_goal — two accepted goals with invocations give fable_tokens_per_accepted_goal and fable_share; no accepted goals gives None values without raising

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_interactive_by_goal_marks_approximation_and_never_reads_prompts — with _interactive_summary patched to return two sessions, tokens split across two overlapping goals and every row carries method session_overlap_approximate and model_source assumed_models_planner; malformed jsonl lines are skipped and counted

risks.issue: snapshot()'s field list treats fix_round_for as a direct task field, but every existing caller (strategy.py, scorecard.py, spawn.py, attribution.py, speculation.py, planner_runs.py) reads it from task["constraints"]["fix_round_for"], never top-level. If snapshot() does task.get('fix_round_for') it will always be None, silently breaking materiality()'s fix_strategy_for detection (a held task gaining a fix-round child would never register as material) with no error surfaced.

materiality()'s 'escalated' definition includes 'a result flag escalate', but snapshot()'s own schema ({status, depends_on, hold_reason, fix_round_for, parent, created_at}) has no result field at all -- materiality only ever sees before/after snapshots, so this half of the escalated check has no data to read. Either snapshot() needs a result/result-flag field added, or this clause should be dropped from materiality's contract.

interactive_by_goal() is specified to reuse planner_runs._interactive_summary and attribute tokens to goals 'proportionally by turn count', but _interactive_summary(root, cfg, cutoff, now, headless) returns only aggregated per-session token totals (sessions: [{account, session, input_tokens, ...}]) and per (day, account) totals summed across all sessions -- no turn count or per-turn timestamp is ever returned, so proportional-by-turn-count attribution cannot be computed from its output without re-parsing the transcripts (which the spec explicitly forbids as duplicate parsing). The spec's own signature interactive_by_goal(root=None, cfg=None, now=None) also drops _interactive_summary's required cutoff and headless arguments without saying how to derive them.

accepted_goal_summary(root=None) is specified to call scorecard.accepted_goals(root) directly, but accepted_goals's own signature is accepted_goals(root=STATE) -- passing root=None through unresolved crashes on root / "tasks" (NoneType has no /). Needs an explicit 'root = root if root is not None else STATE' before the call, same as the other functions must do for schedlog/_using_root.

snapshot()'s plan_hash is described as 'sha256 of .orchestrator/plan.md (root parent)', but plan.md actually lives at STATE/plan.md, i.e. directly under root itself (see handover.py: plan = STATE / "plan.md"), not under root's parent directory. As worded this will mislead an implementer into hashing ROOT/plan.md (which doesn't exist) instead of root/plan.md.

suggested_spec_changes: snapshot(): read fix_round_for via (task.get('constraints') or {}).get('fix_round_for'), matching every other reader in the codebase, and document that constraints is the source dict.

snapshot(): add a 'result' (or 'result_escalate') field to the per-task dict if materiality() is meant to detect a result-flag escalate; otherwise drop that clause from materiality()'s 'escalated' definition and rely solely on hold_reason containing 'escalat'.

interactive_by_goal(): either change the design to attribute by aggregate session tokens (not turn count) since that's all _interactive_summary exposes, or spec a small addition to _interactive_summary (or a sibling helper) that also returns per-session assistant-turn timestamps/count; also specify how cutoff and headless are derived when calling _interactive_summary from this new function.
accepted_goal_summary(): resolve root to STATE before passing to scorecard.accepted_goals, e.g. 'accepted_goals(root if root is not None else STATE)'.
snapshot()/plan_hash: clarify plan.md's location as root/plan.md, not root's parent directory.
